title: Fragment-based design and synthesis of coumarin-based thiazoles as dual c-MET/STAT-3 inhibitors for potential antitumor agents.
authors: Naguib, Bassem H; Elsebaie, Heba A; Nafie, Mohamed S; Mohamady, Samy; Albujuq, Nader R; Samir Ayed, Aya; Nada, Dina; Khalil, Ahmed F; Hefny, Salma M; Tawfik, Haytham O; Shaldam, Moataz A
one_liner_zh: 该文设计合成香豆素噻唑类双靶点抑制剂并测试抗癌活性，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白激酶，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: c-MET and STAT-3 are significant targets for cancer treatments. Here, we describe a class of very effective dual STAT-3 and c-MET inhibitors with coumarin-based thiazoles (3a-o) as its scaffold. Spectroscopic evidence (NMR, HRMS, and HPLC) validated the structural discoveries of the new compounds. The cytotoxic activity of these compounds was also tested against a panel of cancer cells in accordance with US-NCI guidelines. Compound 3g proved to be active at 10 microM, thus it was automatically scheduled to be tested at five doses. Towards SNB-75 (CNS cancer cell line), compound 3g showed notable in vitro anti-cancer activity with GI(50) = 1.43 muM. For the molecular targets, compound 3g displayed potent activity towards STAT-3 and c-MET having IC(50) of 4.7 microM and 12.67, respectively, compared to Cabozantinib (IC(50) = 15 nM of c-MET) and STAT-3-IN-3 (IC(50) = 2.1 microM of STAT-3). Moreover, compound 3g significantly induced apoptosis in SNB-75 cells, causing a 3.04-fold increase in apoptotic cell death (treated cells exhibited 11.53 % overall apoptosis, against 3.04 % in reference cells) and a 3.58-fold increase in necrosis. Moreover, it arrests cells at the G2 phase. Dual inhibition of c-MET and STAT-3 protein kinase was further validated using RT-PCR. The target compound's binding mechanism was determined by the application of molecular docking.
abstract_zh: c-MET和STAT-3是癌症治疗的重要靶点。在此，我们描述了一类以香豆素基噻唑（3a-o）为骨架的高效双重STAT-3和c-MET抑制剂。光谱证据（NMR、HRMS和HPLC）验证了新化合物的结构发现。根据US-NCI指南，还测试了这些化合物对一组癌细胞的细胞毒性活性。化合物3g在10微摩尔浓度下表现出活性，因此自动被安排进行五个剂量的测试。针对SNB-75（中枢神经系统癌细胞系），化合物3g显示出显著的体外抗癌活性，GI(50) = 1.43微摩尔。在分子靶点方面，化合物3g对STAT-3和c-MET表现出强效活性，IC(50)分别为4.7微摩尔和12.67，与Cabozantinib（c-MET的IC(50) = 15纳摩尔）和STAT-3-IN-3（STAT-3的IC(50) = 2.1微摩尔）相比。此外，化合物3g显著诱导SNB-75细胞凋亡，使凋亡细胞死亡增加3.04倍（处理细胞表现出11.53%的总凋亡率，而参考细胞为3.04%），坏死增加3.58倍。此外，它使细胞阻滞在G2期。通过RT-PCR进一步验证了c-MET和STAT-3蛋白激酶的双重抑制。通过分子对接应用确定了目标化合物的结合机制。
